about_the_game:
Thruster is a precision based rocket control game where every move counts.
Pilot your rocket through tight spaces, deadly traps, and physics-based challenges. There’s no health bar one wrong move and you're toast. It’s all about precision, timing, and smart fuel management.

Current Features:

  • Physics-Based Flight — Control your rocket using thrusters to move, hover, and boost.

  • Fuel System — Limited fuel keeps the pressure on. Find pickups to stay airborne.

  • Traps — Every level is rigged with traps, some move, some surprise.

  • Test Levels — 5 early levels built for testing mechanics and gathering feedback. (These are planned for the playtest and will appear in early screenshots, but won’t be part of the final release, will be updated over time.)

Planned Features:

  • Expanded Traps — More variety like shifting walls, floating objects, and dynamic obstacles.

  • Leaderboards — Race for the fastest times and compete for top scores.

  • 30+ Levels on Full Release — A full set of challenging maps with refined gameplay and visuals.

Thruster is a solo-developed project, it's currently in development and will be free to play on release. Everything from visuals to mechanics is a work in progress.

Thanks for checking it out. It means a lot!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU @ 2.0 GHz or (Intel Core i3, AMD Ryzen 3)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or AMD RX 560
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Anything capable of producing sound.

short_description: Pilot your rocket through a maze of obstacles! Navigate tight spaces, manage your limited fuel, control your thrust as you search for the exit. Precision and timing are everything, one wrong move and it’s total destruction!
